simple.meaning: מִנִּית (Minnîyth) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H4511). BibleIQ follows its 2 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Judges, Ezekiel, beginning at Judges 11:33. The surrounding context includes land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name מִנִּית (H4511).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.

definitions.short: Minnith , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H4511. Minnith מִנִּית proper name, of a location in Ammonite territory, site unknown (4 Roman miles from Heshbon Euseb. Onom. 253, 33 ; compare Buhl Geogr. 266 ); — Judg 11:33 ( ᵐ5 ἄχρις Ἀρνών , A εἰς Σεμωειθ , ᵐ5 L Σεμενειθ ); מ ׳חִטֵּי Ezek 27:17 wheat of Minnîth (compare wheat from Ammon 2Chr 27:5 ) so Berthol, but dubious; Co conjectures וּנְכאֹת חִטִּים wheat and storax . [ מְנֻסָה ] see מְנוּסָה below נוס .
